subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth attention in these incident descriptions.

judge.implied_focus: The nature and characterization of IT incidents (what the incident is about and its notable operational attributes) as extracted from free-text descriptions

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Classifies the incident domain (database, email, vpn, etc.), a core facet of characterizing what an incident is about.

per_column.name: affected_system_component
per_column.rationale: Identifies the specific component affected, refining the category into actionable technical granularity.

per_column.name: failure_symptom_type
per_column.rationale: Captures the type of failure/symptom, a distinct and coherent facet of incident nature.

per_column.name: scope_indicator
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes individual vs system-wide vs location-specific impact, a meaningful severity/attention dimension inferable from text.

per_column.name: self_resolved_indicator
per_column.rationale: A resolution attribute of the incident; loosely tied to incident characterization though drifting toward lifecycle metadata.

per_column.name: cross_assigned_indicator
per_column.rationale: A routing/handling process attribute not derivable from the description content; drifts away from the 'what's in the text' focus.

per_column.name: opened_hour_bucket
per_column.rationale: Derived from opened_at timestamp, not from the description; a temporal metadata facet unrelated to incident nature inference.

per_column.name: recurrence_within_period
per_column.rationale: A cross-record temporal derivation, not a text-inferable characterization of the individual incident's nature.

judge.rationale: The strongest columns (incident_category, affected_system_component, failure_symptom_type, scope_indicator) cohere well around a single inferable focus -- characterizing the nature and impact of incidents from their descriptions -- forming a sound multi-facet structure at useful granularity (domain, component, symptom, scope). However, the set drifts: cross_assigned_indicator, opened_hour_bucket, and recurrence_within_period are process/temporal/cross-record derivations not grounded in the description text, pulling the column set toward a broader 'incident triage metadata' grab-bag rather than one tight focus. This dilutes coherence. The implied focus is genuinely actionable -- an analyst can prioritize by category, scope, and symptom -- but the mixed lifecycle/temporal facets prevent a clean single-focus structure.
